name: Search and Navigation
description: Practice searching for files, reading specific lines, and navigating the filesystem.

tasks.description: Create 4 files: report-2024.txt, report-2025.txt, notes.txt, draft.txt. Then search for all files matching the pattern 'report-*.txt' and write the matching filenames to found.txt (one per line).

Create two files: animals.txt with content 'cat
dog
bird
fish' and colors.txt with content 'red
green
blue'. Read animals.txt and use the content to create a file named pets.txt containing only lines with 'cat' or 'dog'.
Create a file named lines.txt with 10 lines: 'Line 1' through 'Line 10'. Read only lines 4-6 from it. Write just those 3 lines to excerpt.txt.
